name: Terms of Affection
overview: Lawyer Sheng Yan casually uses her boss as an excuse to fake a confession during a blind date, only to be overheard by the boss himself. By a twist of fate, they get married, and she moves into his wealthy household. Amid sweet flirtations and intense push-and-pull, they break down each other's walls, discovering a love filled with unique devotion and unwavering protection.
